extra_quotes: Time‑domain THz emission spectroscopy was performed using 800 nm (1.55 eV) laser femtosecond pulses as the optical pump.
An amplified Ti:sapphire femtosecond laser system (80 fs pulses, 250 kHz repetition rate) was used.
Emitted THz radiation was collected and focused by four off-axis parabolic mirrors onto a 1-mm-thick ZnTe electro-optic crystal for time-domain sampling.
